TAGRISSO (osimertinib) — 3rd Generation EGFR TKI
MECHANISM: Covalently binds EGFR exon 19 del, L858R (sensitizing mutations) AND T790M resistance mutation. Also CNS-penetrant — crosses blood-brain barrier effectively.
KEY INDICATIONS: - 1st line NSCLC: EGFR exon 19 del or L858R (FLAURA trial) - 2nd line: T790M mutation after 1st/2nd gen EGFR TKI (AURA3) - Adjuvant: Stage IB-IIIA resected NSCLC with EGFR mutation (ADAURA)
DOSING: 80 mg oral OD (once daily). No food restrictions. 40 mg dose for toxicity reduction.
KEY TRIAL DATA: - FLAURA: 18.9 months PFS vs 10.2 months (gefitinib/erlotinib). OS benefit 38.6 vs 31.8 months. - FLAURA2: Tagrisso + chemo combo — 25.5 months PFS in 1st line - ADAURA: 80% DFS reduction at 3 years in adjuvant setting (Stage II-IIIA) - AURA3: 10.1 months PFS in T790M+ 2nd line (vs 4.4 months chemo)
CNS ACTIVITY: 22% intracranial ORR. Essential for patients with brain mets — differentiation from 1st/2nd gen TKIs.
BIOMARKER: EGFR mutation testing mandatory. Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) available for T790M in progression.
RESISTANCE MECHANISMS: C797S mutation, MET amplification, SCLC transformation — know these for scientific discussions.
SAFETY: Rash, diarrhea, dry skin, paronychia. QTc prolongation possible. Interstitial lung disease (rare but serious).
VS IRESSA/TARCEVA: Superior PFS, OS, CNS penetration, and covers T790M resistance.

TAGRISSO (osimertinib) — Rep ke liye Key Points
KYA HAI: Teen generation ka sabse advanced EGFR tablet. Pehli aur doosri generation se better isliye ki yeh T790M resistance bhi cover karta hai, aur brain mein bhi kaam karta hai.
KAHAN USE HOTA HAI: - Pehli line mein EGFR mutated lung cancer (exon 19 ya L858R) - Jab pehli line EGFR TKI ke baad T790M mutation aaye - Surgery ke baad (adjuvant) EGFR+ patients mein — cancer wapas aane se rokta hai
DOSE: 80 mg ek tablet roz, khaane ke saath ya bina. Simple.
DOCTOR SE KAISE BAAT KAREIN: - "FLAURA trial mein Tagrisso ne almost double kiya PFS — 19 months vs 10 months." - "Brain mets wale patients ke liye yeh bahut important hai — brain ke andar bhi kaam karta hai." - "ADAURA data — surgery ke baad bhi 80% kam chance cancer wapas aane ka." - "T790M liquid biopsy se pata karo — aur Tagrisso ready hai."
RESISTANCE KE BAAD: C797S ya MET amplification aane par discuss karein — scientific conversation ke liye great opening.
SIDE EFFECTS: Thodi rash, diarrhea, nails affected ho sakte hain. Yeh manageable hain. Serious — ILD (rare) ke baare mein doctor ko warn karein.
VS IRESSA/TARCEVA: "Sir, pehli aur doosri generation se Tagrisso clearly better hai — data aur CNS coverage dono mein."
